questions.questionText: Look at the picture marked No. 1 in your test book and choose the best statement:
questions.questionTextVi: Nhìn vào bức tranh số 1 trong sách bài thi và chọn câu miêu tả đúng nhất:

options.A: The worker is carrying some plants.
options.B: The worker is reading a sign.
options.C: The worker is pushing a cart.
options.D: The worker is writing some notes.

optionsVi.A: (A) Người công nhân đang mang vác một số chậu cây.
optionsVi.B: (B) Người công nhân đang đọc một tấm biển báo.
optionsVi.C: (C) Người công nhân đang đẩy một chiếc xe chở hàng.
optionsVi.D: (D) Người công nhân đang ghi chép một số ghi chú.

questions.explanation: Phương án (D) miêu tả chính xác hành động trong bức ảnh: Người phụ nữ làm việc tại vườn ươm cây đang cầm bảng kẹp tài liệu và cầm bút ghi chép ('is writing some notes'). Cô ấy không mang vác cây (loại A), không đọc biển báo (loại B) và chiếc xe đẩy đang đứng yên chứ không ai đang đẩy (loại C).

questions.questionText: There’s a meeting in the conference room soon, right?
questions.questionTextVi: Sắp có một cuộc họp ở phòng hội nghị, đúng không?

options.A: Yes, it’s for the whole department.
options.B: No, put it in the closet.

optionsVi.B: (B) Không, hãy cất nó vào trong tủ đồ.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi xác nhận thông tin: 'There’s a meeting... right?'. Phương án (A) xác nhận 'Yes' và bổ sung thông tin đối tượng tham gia: 'it’s for the whole department' (Dành cho cả phòng ban). Phương án (B) và (C) bẫy từ 'room' (closet, rent).

(C) The rent is too high.

optionsVi.C: (C) Buổi sáng thường phù hợp hơn đối với tôi.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi lựa chọn 'in the morning or the afternoon?'. Phương án (C) đưa ra lựa chọn rõ ràng: 'Mornings are usually better for me' (Buổi sáng thích hợp hơn). Phương án (A) và (B) không đưa ra lựa chọn thời gian.

questions.passageText: Questions 176-180 refer to the following e-mail and Web page. From: Subject: Date: E-Mail Messa e Cassie Raferty <cassie@mailcurrent.ie> Youssef Zimri <zimri@zimrimechanical.ie> Following up 12 September Attachment: cmcclinic Dear Ms. Raferty, I am very happy with your work so far. Your suggestion to add photos from our archive certainly dressed up the "Company History" page. The help-wanted pop-up bubble on the home page also looks good. Hopefully, it will attract applicants with mechanical experience. I'd like you to add one more project to our "Portfolio" page. We have finally finished replacing the plumbing and heating systems at Clary Medical Centre's satellite clinic in Galway. It was a challenging job, and I'm proud of our results. The attachment contains photos and a short description of what we did there. Sincerely, Youssef Zimri Owner, Zimri Mechanical https://www.clarymedicalcentre.ie About News Staff Contact Us Clinic opening soon We have repurposed 47 High Street, Galway, into a satellite medical clinic and will celebrate with a grand opening party on Friday, 28 October. Questions 191-195 refer to the following job flyer, and article. Gallery manager at Richard Lahiri Gallery in Cromwood Applicants for this full-time position must have experience in retail art with an established history of successfully attracting patrons interested in purchasing original works of art. Experience managing a social media account is also desired. The position will be primarily on-site; however, some remote hours can be scheduled. Candidates must be available to start work on or before April l. Qualified applicants should contact gallery director Richard Lahiri at rlahiri@richardlahirigallery.com. Summer Scene Arts Program Starting on May 1, five art galleries in Cromwood will be hosting open houses every Friday from May through August. Come enjoy live music, refreshments, artist talks, and more on the Cromwood boardwalk. Activities start at 4:00 P.M. and continue until 9:30 P.M., rain or shine. Participating galleries are listed below. Rita Blake Art • Siitva Gallery • Richard Lahiri Gallery Patricia Dolivo Painting • Ashland Pottery and Crafts Funded by the Cromwood City Council and Regents Bank 164

Summer Activities in Middleton County Compiled by Lisa Yu-Seaver Cromwood Art Nights Residents of Elmhurst, Melbridge, and Cromwood are invited to explore the local art scene in Cromwood this summer. The five galleries on the boardwalk overlooking the Wye River are holding special events each Friday as part of the Summer Scene Arts Program. This Friday, Richard Lahiri and his gallery manager, Geetu Gelang, will use a giant screen to demonstrate software for creating virtual art. The event will also feature craft vendors, food trucks, and live music. See www.cromwood.gov/things-to-do for more information. Movies in Brady Park The popular summer movie series in Herrontown returns on June 16! Each Saturday evening, a classic film will be projected on Brady Park's Grand Lawn. Bring your picnic basket and a blanket and get comfortable! The schedule of films is available at www.bradypark.org/activities.

questions.passageTitle: Part 7: Triple Passage: Article, Email, and Table (Câu 196-200)
questions.passageText:
Questions 196-200 refer to the following article, memo, and policy. Senano Designs Buys Gendalla in $60 Million Deal LOS ANGELES (March powerhouse Senano Designs announced on Wednesday that it had acquired Gendalla, an up-and-coming luxury brand. The acquisition is part of Senano's plan to supplement its clothing products with a line of designer watches. Over the next two years, the company has further plans to expand its offerings to include fragrances and luggage. Lina Pacheco, Senano's chief MEMO executive officer, said that such expansion is necessary to keep up and compete with other international fashion houses. Although based in Los Angeles, in recent years Senano has opened offices in Philadelphia, Chicago, and Miami. Ms. Pacheco says she was unfamiliar with Gendalla products until a year ago, when she saw one of their ads in an automobile magazine. ' 'The products have a distinctive, modern style," Ms. Pacheco said, "which will go well with Senano's trendsetting clothes." From: Date: Subject: Oscar Johansen, Accounting department All Gendalla employees March 22 Travel expense policy Attachment: Policy I have attached a copy of Senano's policy on travel expenses, which will go into effect when we offcially become employees of Senano on March 31. Note that Senano's policy is more restrictive than Gendalla's policy in several ways. For example, employees will no longer have one month to submit expense reports. However, the new policy will make some processes much easier: specifically, Senano's requirements for submitting expenses under $50 are simpler than those under current Gendalla policy. Carlie Dawson, an accounting director who works at Senano's headquarters, will come to our New York office to lead an information session about this and other policy-related changes on Thursday, March 28, at 2:00 P.M. I strongly encourage you to attend. 166

Senano Designs Travel Expense Policy • To be reimbursed for work-related travel, employees must submit a travel request at least two weeks before a trip, listing the reason for travel and estimating all expenses. • Original receipts must be submitted for expenses above $50. Any expenses below that do not require the submission of original receipts. • All receipts and expense reports must be submitted within three weeks after a trip is completed. Expenses submitted after this time will require the approval
